title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: This release fixes Remove Test Only Code leaving a broken import behind in a main source file when the removed declaration was used only by its own tests.

highlights.title: Safer Test Only Code Removal
highlights.description: Removing code kept alive only by its tests no longer leaves a broken import behind in a main source file, so the module keeps compiling.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed Remove Test Only Code leaving a stale import in a main source file. When a declaration was removed because only its tests used it, a main file that imported it without using it kept that import, and the module failed to compile in Kotlin or Java. The command now clears these imports too, once the removal itself is already decided from the tests alone: an import can never be the reason a withheld removal gets offered.
